pages.article_html:
The Unforgotten

Level 5 · Adventuring · Tanvu · Kojan

Go into the house to the north and look for remains of a Jin Warrior. Juu hinted that they might be on the roof.

Objectives

Discover the Remains

Description

1) Speak to Juu in Tanvu. 2) Examine the Jin Warriors Remains on the roof of the house to the north. 3) Return to Juu.

Notes

Enter the house and go upstairs. Climb out the window and then use the planks to get to the roof. There is a clickable body on the roof. On the body is Last Words. Return to Juu

4 recorded disagreements about this quest — ends npc (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80), level (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80), level (the Forgotten Horde wiki), prev quest (silkyvenom).

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

Objectives as recorded by fandom

Remains Discovered Go into the house to the north and look for remains of a Jin Warrior. Juu hinted that they might be on the roof. ...The last stand was stage on the roof, and a few of us it it out alive...

findings.observation: Training With Juu displays level 5, Adventuring, Tanvu, Kojan, Oki as starter and Previous Kojuko Gluttons. Objectives directs finding Juu on the hill to the north and visiting trainers near him. The second crawler-attributed objective repeats that wording; repetition is not independent corroboration.

Training With Juu has no explicit hand-in or Next field in this cached article. Kojuko Gluttons links Next Training With Juu and Kojuko Manhunters links Previous Training With Juu, while the separately titled Juu (Quest) has its own navigation. These labels do not establish identity equivalence or enforced prerequisites.

The Unforgotten displays level 5, Juu as starter and hand-in, Tanvu, Dallerjuba Village, Previous Kojuko Manhunters and Next The Unforgotten - Part 2. Objectives prints Discover the Remains; the fandom-attributed objective prints Remains Discovered and roof instructions. Operative completion mechanics remain unverified.

The Unforgotten Description instructs speaking to Juu, examining Jin Warriors Remains on the northern house roof and returning to Juu. Notes describes stairs, a window and planks, a clickable body and Last Words. Last Words is preserved as a textual reference; no canonical item ID, loot entitlement, required item quantity or interaction script is inferred.

The Unforgotten preserves four attributed disagreements: ends npc and level from wiki.silkyvenom.com:80, level from the Forgotten Horde wiki, and prev quest from silkyvenom. Alternate values are absent in the visible disagreement text, so these conflicts remain unresolved and the full source records are retained.

Training With Juu Location prints -16408, -49970, 187. The Unforgotten Location prints -21770, -62875, 3344; its map separately prints Starts spot 8, Juu, Tanvu (-21711, -67633). Coordinate units, conversions and verified spawns remain unknown.
Both articles explicitly display Repeatable No. Neither displays a coin reward field in the cached Details. Absence does not establish a zero reward.

Training With Juu links a Telon Project wikidot quest page. The Unforgotten links the archived MMODB quest page. This review uses cached vgsoharchive transcriptions; linked originals were not fetched or independently verified.
